item.description: The latest Malayalam film, Bha Bha Bha, opened with Rs. 7.25 crore on its debut day at the Kerala box office. Directed by Dhananjay Shankar, Bha Bha Bha is set for a glorious run further and can secure a place among the top grossers of all time. item.title: Taylor Swift Addresses Joe Alwyn and Matty Healy Breakups in Eras Tour Comment: ‘Men Will Let You Down’
item.description: Taylor Swift is gearing up for a loving marriage to Kansas City Chiefs player Travis Kelce, but her path to reaching him wasn’t very smooth. Having been in and out of many relationships, the singer has often taken to venting out her feelings, and this time, a behind-the-scenes look at what went down during her heavily sold-out Eras Tour is revealing her thoughts about some of the unceremonious moments post her breakups with Joe Alwyn and Matty Healy, calling them the things that ‘let her down’.
